basics.name: Luis Sánchez Elvira
basics.headline: Systems, support and code.
basics.role: L1/L2 IT support and junior developer
basics.summary: IT professional with L1/L2 support experience at Telefónica Tech and the Spanish Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and web development experience with ASP.NET and JavaScript. I finish my Computer Engineering degree in 2027 and I am looking for a junior role in support, systems or development.

about: I have worked in L1/L2 support in demanding corporate environments. At Minsait I resolved 10 to 15 L2 incidents a day for Telefónica Tech, with SLA compliance above 95%, and at Ibermática I supported more than 1,000 users at the Spanish Ministry of Foreign Affairs, in an environment with strict security requirements.
I have also built internal web applications with ASP.NET (C#), JavaScript and SQL Server, working on production code with Git and peer code review.

I am studying for a BSc in Computer Engineering, with two distinctions with honours, and preparing for the Cisco CCNA. I like building things that work and understanding why the ones that don't are failing: this site, for example, is hosted by me.

experience.role: Web developer intern, Software Development Department
bullets: Developed and maintained internal applications (intranet and academic management) in ASP.NET (C#) with a JavaScript SPA frontend.
Built new features and fixed bugs in production code, including SQL Server queries and data modelling.
Worked in a team using Git version control and peer code review.
Resolved 10 to 15 L2 incidents a day on Telefónica Tech products (background music, fleet and content management), with SLA compliance above 95%.
Provided technical support and mentoring to L1 colleagues and on-site technicians, reducing unnecessary escalations.
Managed and tracked tickets in Jira and EasyVista.

experience.role: L1/L2 service desk, client: Spanish Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MAEC)
bullets: Provided L1/L2 support to more than 1,000 MAEC users, in an environment with strict security requirements.
Administered Active Directory (users, groups and permissions) and provided advanced Microsoft 365 support.
Installed and maintained corporate hardware: printers, fingerprint readers and peripherals.

experience.role: Programmer analyst intern and technical support
bullets: Programmer analyst (Mar 2022 – Jun 2022): resolved software incidents, diagnosed issues with SQL queries and tracked bugs in Jira.
Technical support (Oct 2020 – Nov 2021): on-site and remote support to internal users in Spanish and English, device imaging with SCCM and basic Active Directory administration.
